BIBLE DETECTIVE

THE MYSTERY FILES

Every clue reveals the truth.

Investigate Bible mysteries, uncover clues, and identify the characters behind each story.

Disclaimer: This game aims to share the Word of God in an educational and respectful way. It is not intended to offend, criticize, or disrespect any religion or belief.

Please note: Bible passage links lead to external websites. Access may vary depending on your country or region.

Detective handbook

HOW TO PLAY

Your mission

  1. Choose Old Testament or New Testament.
  2. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty to view its case files.
  3. Choose a Bible mystery.
  4. Read the clue and look at the illustration.
  5. Choose the correct character from four answers.
  6. Reveal another clue if you need help.
  7. Correct answers earn points: 10 for the first clue, 5 for the second, and 2 for the third. Incorrect guesses have no penalty.

Scoring system

Clue 1: 10 points · Clue 2: 5 points · Clue 3: 2 points

Earn up to 10 points per case. Keep investigating and learning at your own pace!
